title: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving

entities.name: Auntie Grub
entities.description: A boggart auntie who narrates the tale to the young boggarts in her hut.

entities.name: Nitwik
entities.description: A young boggart who keeps interrupting Auntie Grub's story.

entities.name: Ygril
entities.description: A bold boggart who leads the raid on Boeb's lair, grows into a giant with a potion and is nearly boiled in milk.

entities.name: Flib
entities.description: A boggart with a singed eye who finds the eternalisk scale and is crushed by Boeb.

entities.name: Lugg
entities.description: A boggart quicker on his feet who scouts and flees on Marrja, then returns to save Ygril.

entities.name: Naance
entities.description: A whining boggart who wanted to raid Bre's lair and helps fly Marrja.

entities.name: Marrja
entities.description: The boggarts' large, ferocious eagle mount that carries loot and rakes Boeb's face.

entities.name: Boeb of Boldwyr
entities.description: An old giant of Clan Boldwyr, legendary for killing boggarts, who is actually grieving his father and is blinded by Marrja.

entities.name: Boeb's father
entities.description: The giant who hunted the eternalisk and gave Boeb its scale; his death sent Boeb into name sleep.

entities.name: Bre of Stoutarm
entities.description: A milder giant whose lair the boggarts first planned to raid but which is in Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Horp
entities.description: A famous boggart who wrangled a giant hornet and rides it as a mount.

entities.name: Cloudgoat
entities.description: Boeb's huge winged goat mount, in pain from unmilked udders.

entities.name: Eternalisk
entities.description: An immortal creature of the high mountains whose scales make potent healing charms.

entities.name: Eternalisk scale
entities.description: A shimmering scale from an eternalisk that Boeb wears around his neck, a gift from his father.

entities.name: Reliquary of Dawn
entities.description: A reliquary that lets a bearer cross the barrier into Shadowmoor, kept in Boeb's lair.

entities.name: Thousand-Year Elixir
entities.description: A golden potion in a labeled phial in Boeb's lair that Ygril wonders about.

entities.name: Boeb's lair
entities.description: A cave beneath a bushy hill marked by a giant dolmen, full of treasure.

entities.name: Blessed Nation
entities.description: The known expanse of Lorwyn, across which lies Bre's lair.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The night aspect of the plane, whose barrier has shifted over the pass.

entities.name: Boggarts
entities.description: Goblin-like creatures who raid giants' lairs and fear no death without reward.

events.summary: Auntie Grub begins telling the young boggarts the tale of four friends who raided a giant's lair.
events.quote: Today's tale is the story of four enterprising boggarts and how they raided a giant's lair

events.summary: Ygril's group finds the pass to Bre's lair has gone into Shadowmoor and decides instead to raid Boeb's lair.
events.quote: the lair belonged to Boeb of Clan Boldwyr.

events.summary: Ygril persuades the others by promising fame greater than Horp's, and sends Lugg and Flib to scout.
events.quote: We'll be the first boggarts to successfully rob Boeb.

events.summary: The boggarts approach Boeb's territory on Marrja and discover seven dead boggarts hanging from a tree.
events.quote: just up ahead were seven dead boggarts hanging from the low branch of a tree.

events.summary: Ygril hears Boeb snoring and explains giants' name sleep, so the boggarts enter the lair.
events.quote: a giant's slumber was something called name sleep, triggered only by a sudden change such as trauma or abundance.

events.summary: The boggarts find the sleeping Boeb looks genial rather than terrible.
events.quote: Boeb the Terrible did not look quite so terrible.

events.summary: The boggarts loot the lair, ferrying treasures away on Marrja, while Ygril secretly stuffs her pouch with potions.
events.quote: The friends had agreed to evenly share the loot, but Ygril wanted the choicest potions for herself.

events.summary: Flib climbs onto Boeb's chest with an eternalisk scale and begins hacking at its string with his axe.
events.quote: Flib, as if reading her mind, produced his axe and began to hack at the rope.

events.summary: Boeb's cloudgoat arrives bleating, startling Flib, whose axe falls into Boeb's flesh and wakes him.
events.quote: to bury itself, just as Ygril had feared, firmly in Boeb's flesh.

events.summary: Boeb wakes and crushes Flib, and Ygril falls into a copper bucket of old milk and is trapped.
events.quote: He twitched, slapped his chest, and crushed poor Flib.

events.summary: Boeb rages at the thieves; Lugg and Naance flee on Marrja.
Boeb threatens to dismember and hang the hidden Ygril, but she stays quiet in the bucket.
events.quote: Then Boeb will pluck your arms from their joints and suck the marrow from them.

events.summary: Boeb's sorrow is revealed: his father's death sent him into name sleep, and the scale was his father's gift.
events.quote: He had lost his father, and he was so overcome by grief that he had fallen into name sleep.

events.summary: Boeb milks the cloudgoat into the bucket, nearly drowning Ygril, and then puts the bucket over the fire to boil.
events.quote: There came the unmistakable crackle of flames as Boeb settled the bucket over the furnace.

events.summary: Scalded, Ygril drinks a green potion and grows into a giant, wrecking the cave.
events.quote: Ygril realized then that she was a giant.

events.summary: Boeb and giant Ygril brawl; he hurls standing stones and begins choking her as the potion wears off.
events.quote: Worse, the potion was spent, and she was starting to shrink to her normal size.

events.summary: Lugg and Naance return on Marrja, who rakes Boeb's face and tears out his eyes while Ygril pins him.
events.quote: to sink her talons into his eyes and tear them out.

events.summary: The boggarts escape with their loot and celebrate Flib back in their burrow.
events.quote: They celebrated Flib—who died foolishly, yes, but in service of something greater.

relations.quote: Flib guiding their mount Marrja—a large and ferocious eagle—by her harness.

relations.note: Boeb crushes Flib when he wakes.
relations.quote: He twitched, slapped his chest, and crushed poor Flib.

relations.note: Boeb is said to feast on boggarts and hangs thieves from a tree.
relations.quote: he feasted on boggarts and made flutes of their bones.
The eternalisk scale about his neck had been a gift from his father
It was Boeb's mount, the only creature large enough for a giant to ride.

relations.note: Auntie Grub scolds and teaches the young boggarts.
relations.quote: listen to your Auntie Grub impart some boggart wisdom.

relations.note: Ygril gathered the friends to plan the heist.
relations.quote: when Ygril had gathered them to plan this heist

relations.note: The dolmen and lair are Boeb's.
